system.description: This fearsome mastery of Fortitude allows you to overcome one of the traditional banes of the undead: the feared stake. You may subsume a stake that pierces your heart, reshaping the dead organ around it and insulating it from the offending wood. Spend a permanent Willpower Trait and succeed in a Static Physical Challenge (nine Traits) to attempt this; if successful, spend one to five temporary Physical Traits to determine how long it takes before your body rejects the stake and you rise from immobilization: one Trait for one year, two for six months, three for one month, four for one week, five for one night. The power works the same way regardless of how many temporary Physical Traits you spend. Each use affects only one stake; if you suffer the same fate again, you may attempt this again by spending the Willpower Trait once more. If the Static Physical Challenge is lost, the body does not expel the stake, and no further attempt may be made against that particular stake. Once turned away from the heart, the stake remains lodged in your body, overgrown by dead flesh (and possibly visible beneath clothing), until you choose to cut it out, suffering two aggravated health levels of damage in the process.
system.source: Clanbook: Ventrue, Chapter Two: The King is Dead, Long Live the King
system.duration: One night to one year, depending on Traits spent
